title: Preserve frozen experiments and bind the repaired subject explicitly
problem: The SR-001 authority/recovery correction changes the actual gate and workflow classes. Seventeen old experiment tests still bind the original subject, one rollback emits the old checkpoint shape, and harmless fixtures omit the newly required retry contract.
baseline: Original main bcbb1ab4a0c42cda4a97aec42a11125753962762: 495 passed. Draft a50f5ff677312cc78e6d64a603a005143de7edfd: reproduced 522 passed / 17 failed. Original Package 3/4 seals and alternatives remain unchanged.

alternatives.name: Explicit current subject plus bounded data migration
alternatives.description: Keep frozen spec and baseline bytes, opt into a fixed SR001 subject binding, and explicitly convert only valid interrupted harmless W0 checkpoints.
advantages: Preserves refusal evidence and useful experiment functionality
No runtime authority or canonical package changes
alternatives.revival_evidence: Current experiment and negative controls pass; unreviewed binding still refuses.

alternatives.name: Freeze all experiments on old main
alternatives.description: Retain original benchmark only; leave successor compatibility blocked.
disadvantages: Does not close legitimate compatibility seam
alternatives.revival_evidence: Revert successor experiment if it cannot preserve invariants.

alternatives.name: Automatic checkpoint inference or recomputed seals
alternatives.description: Infer missing retry permission or accept a dynamically measured source fingerprint.
disadvantages: Launders an unknown outcome or drift into acceptance
alternatives.revival_evidence: Never revive authority inference; any future general migrator needs a separate bounded decision and external-effect reconciliation.

do_nothing_option.expected_outcome: The 17 incompatibilities continue to block adoption.
disadvantages: Historical status conceals an active incompatibility if adoption proceeds anyway

roles.position: Preserve useful developmental competence and the original goal; this is a dependency repair.
material_concerns: A green experiment is not persistent founder-loop closure

roles.position: One canonical runtime and explicit version-bound test subjects; use existing schema validation.
material_concerns: No parallel ledger, authority engine, framework or automatic state adoption

roles.position: Historical assertions must still verify original bytes; omitted retry permission must refuse.
material_concerns: Changing expectations can manufacture a pass unless original failures and source binding survive

roles.position: Explicit opt-in CLI and data-only migration keep rollback concrete.
material_concerns: Default old experiment still fails against changed current source; full Git history is required for baseline tests

roles.position: Do not turn test results, hashes or synthetic workload credentials into real verified progress or founder authentication.
material_concerns: Single-author review is not independent review; external consequences are not reversible through software rollback

evidence.claim: Original experiments are still executable on their baseline
evidence.finding: 495 passed under the independently enforced no-network launcher.

evidence.claim: Explicit compatibility repair preserves current tests and negative controls

counterevidence.claim: Runtime grants and unknown effects cannot be reconstructed from legacy checkpoints
counterevidence.finding: Malformed, terminal, uncertain, invalid-identity and omitted retry-contract inputs refuse.

pass_1.intended_outcome: Repair only the active compatibility seam while preserving the original experiment and authority boundaries. This is the narrow new subject-version decision, not a third SR-001 architectural strengthening pass.

advantages.statement: Keep old and current evidence separately source-bound
advantages.amplified_value: Future component replacements can be compared without rewriting the past; the value reverses if subject definitions proliferate without owners.

disadvantages.statement: A caller-supplied retry contract does not prove real harmlessness
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Keep conversion data-only and explicit; limit use to reviewed harmless fixtures. No production auto-migration, grant or execution.

disadvantages.statement: A new subject binding might erase original negative evidence
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Keep original spec seals, old Git source tests, baseline run and red log. Reject arbitrary bindings and retain default frozen behavior.

comparisons.baseline: Old main passes but lacks shared security/durability corrections.
comparisons.simplest_viable_alternative: Keep experiments pinned to old main only; insufficient for useful successor compatibility.
comparisons.strongest_competing_architecture: A general workflow migration engine adds cost and authority ambiguity without demand.
comparisons.reversible_experiment: Fixed explicit subject and narrow W0-to-v2 data adapter; neither changes active runtime ownership.

rejected_alternatives.name: Retune seals or silently infer retry safety
rejected_alternatives.rejection_reason: Would manufacture compatibility and permit unknown effects.
rejected_alternatives.revival_evidence: No revival of missing authority inference; a general migration proposal requires new evidence and a separate decision.

pass_2.attack_summary: Attack the version binding and adapter as if already adopted: unreviewed source, malformed history, uncertainty, changed step contracts and misleading green counts.

new_weaknesses.statement: Fresh CI checkouts may lack the historical Git objects
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: Fetch complete history in the existing test workflows; source checks fail if history is missing instead of silently re-sealing.

pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.rationale: No runtime caller or automatic dispatch added; meaningful use remains limited to reviewed harmless fixtures.
pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.review_trigger: Any proposed production migration or consequential retry

pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.rationale: Original frozen specs, source bytes in Git, 495 baseline, red log and explicit opt-in remain.
pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.review_trigger: Any change to a seal, subject digest, test corpus or threshold

pass_2.final_design: EXPERIMENT: explicit fixed SR001 subject with original sealed spec; narrow validated data-only migration; full-history CI; no package ownership or authority change.

residual_risks.risk: Single-author perspectives are not independent review
residual_risks.mitigation: Keep adoption held pending independent review; do not claim consensus.

residual_risks.risk: Historical runtime cannot safely consume arbitrary new durable state
residual_risks.mitigation: Rollback code only after stopping writers and reconciling retained state; never erase accepted work.
residual_risks.review_trigger: Any rollback after v2 history is written

dissent.handling: Preserved. Five perspectives are one assistant's analysis, not five independent reviewers. The bounded implementation is authorized; adoption is not.

entries.position: Keep adoption held despite local green tests.
entries.rationale: New binding proves only explicit experiment compatibility; Docker, newest-main composition and independent review remain separate.
entries.evidence_threshold: Exact final candidate gates and independent adoption review.

migration_plan: Use --subject sr001 explicitly. Keep W0/W2 adapters and specs unchanged. For reviewed harmless fixtures, validate W0, supply explicit retry-safe step contract, preserve identity/state/time, append the v2 record, close/reopen and resume. Unknown consequential outcomes remain blocked.

steps: Revert this compatibility commit while retaining evidence and original alternative history.
Stop writers and preserve every accepted record before any executable rollback.
Do not feed v2 history to old software without a separately validated migration; software restoration cannot undo external effects.

kill_criteria: Original negative evidence or thresholds are deleted or silently changed
Component replacement creates authority or loses mission continuity
decision_owner: Kernel maintainer within the 2026-09-09 bounded founder direction
review_trigger: Any broader migration, subject/seal change, authority change, or adoption
